scope: Standard P1 helicopter/Black Hawk source and engage_apache structural weapon-controller audit; not a complete engine port

schemaAuthority.note: Third-party reverse-engineered binary layouts. Original game files provide the values. Nested Vector/BranchReference reads and TargetConditionGroup handling are implemented by the independent reader.

findings: ChinGunBurstTime is set to 4 seconds; its recovery Wait has both minimum and maximum 4 seconds. Source-based Minecraft cycle uses 80/80 ticks.

SimpleEngage includes Rocket weight 80, alternate weight 20, and WeaponSelected 2/1. However the referenced legacy rocket controller also has a literal False condition. These weights alone do not prove the actual engine weapon policy.
Hellfire hover requires TimeAvoidHellfire <= 0, blackwatchVariety != 0 and target line of fire; the source initializes the avoidance timer to 15 seconds and sets it to 10 at hover entry.
Hellfire hover includes a 1–2 second pre-aim wait, AimingAtTarget, a 0.2 second Action pulse, then another 1–2 second wait; outer branch permits reevaluation after 5 seconds.

The standard gunship package contains distinct NoseGun/30mm, RocketPodLeft/Right and HellfireLeft/Right paths, including an explicit AI Hellfire user profile and a special AI 30mm profile for tank targets.
Hellfire final has several timed Hit tracks with distinct radii/damage. Current Minecraft rocket damage is not a copy of these original values.

implementationThisCheckpoint.adaptation: Window begins on the first accepted native AI shot. Existing Minecraft four-tick round cadence, damage, range, aiming and friendly-fire rules remain. Manual pilot controls keep their existing cadence.

remaining: Do not mark original weapon selection or guided Hellfire complete. Current helicopter still uses its earlier Minecraft gun/unguided-rocket choice.
MetaObjectData weapon/flight profiles are opaque beyond container boundaries and embedded names. Guidance coefficients and runtime algorithms have not been decoded from them.
Decoding all 388 Apache typed payloads proves layout consistency, not the engine interpretation or complete execution of its branch tree.
Full maneuver reproduction, rendered/audio verification, multiplayer and the broad creature/military/model/audio goal remain open.
